title: A Small Part for a Big Ride
paras: Mina loved riding her bike by the river. One Sunday, she met Luca, her [[italian|Italian]] friend, for a long ride. She put her bag [[on|on]] a bench and checked her bike. The seat moved from side to side. Then a small nut fell [[off|off]]. It went into a hole in the ground below the bench. Without it, the seat was not safe. Mina felt sad. Their ride could not start.

Luca looked [[under|under]] the bench, but he could not see the nut in the hole. “There is a bike shop near here,” he [[say|said]]. “Please [[wait|wait]] here. I can ask for help.” At the shop, he [[describe|described]] the small nut to the woman at the desk. She showed him two sizes. He did not know which one Mina needed, so the woman walked back with him.

The woman brought her [[personal|personal]] tool bag. She found the right nut inside. It cost only twenty [[cent|cents]]. She put it in place and checked the seat again. Now a safe ride was [[possible|possible]]. Mina thanked her. Soon, the two friends were riding beside the water. At their first stop, Mina bought Luca a cold drink.
zh: 米娜喜欢在河边骑自行车。一个星期天，她和意大利朋友卢卡见面，准备骑车远行。她把包放在长椅上，检查了一下自行车。车座左右晃动。接着，一颗小螺母掉了下来，落进了长椅下方地面上的一个洞里。没有它，车座就不安全了。米娜很难过。他们没法出发了。
卢卡看了看长椅下面，但看不到洞里的螺母。“这附近有一家自行车店，”他说，“请在这里等着。我可以去找人帮忙。”到了店里，他向柜台旁的女士描述了那颗小螺母。她拿出两种尺寸给他看。他不知道米娜需要哪一种，于是那位女士和他一起走了回去。
那位女士带来了她自己的工具包。她在里面找到了合适的螺母，只要二十分。她把螺母装好，又检查了一遍车座。现在可以安全骑车了。米娜向她道谢。很快，两个朋友就在河边骑起了车。第一次停下来休息时，米娜给卢卡买了一杯冷饮。

q.s: Mina found a problem with her bike before the ride began.
q.why: 出发前检查时，她发现车座晃动。

q.s: The woman had worked at the bike shop for ten years.
q.why: 文中未提及女士在店里工作的年数。

q.s: The new nut cost fifty cents.
q.why: 正文说螺母只要二十分，不是五十分。
